_comment: LoopStar input FX presets (Phase LI, iPhone). What the mic or instrument goes through on its way into a loop: you hear it while you play (headphones), and it is printed into the take. Fields, all optional (absent = off): compression 0-1; drive {style: lofi|crush|speaker|funk|overdrive, mix 0-100}; pitch semitones -12..12; eq {low, mid, high} dB -12..12; delay {beats (quarter-note beats: 0.75 = dotted eighth), feedback 0-90, mix 0-100}; reverb {space: room|chamber|plate|hall|cathedral, mix 0-100}. Delay is ALWAYS a note value -- it follows the tempo (../LOOPSTAR_SOUL.md). Edit or add here; zero rebuild.
